proposals.note: C3-symmetric block (gen (0,2,4)(1,3,5)): 6 RY for local basis rotation, two interleaved CRX layers (even/odd pairs) for amplitude entanglement, two RZZ layers for phase correlation on adjacent pairs, and two CRZ layers on distance-2 pairs for long-range phase coupling. 7 trainable params spread across 4 gate types to maximize expressiveness within the 24-gate budget. The C3 symmetry reduces effective parameter count while the two-orbit structure (even/odd) preserves enough asymmetry to distinguish connected from disconnected graphs via Z_iZ_j readout. CRX replaces bare CNOT for richer conditional rotations; CRZ on distance-2 pairs captures non-local connectivity signatures that adjacent-pair gates alone miss.

proposals.note: 22-gate block targeting graph connectivity via three mechanisms: (1) RZZ chain (p1-p3) creates pairwise Z-correlations matching the 15 Z_iZ_j observables; (2) CNOT triplet propagates node-state info within pairs while CRZ long-range (0-3,1-4,2-5, p4) bridges across the chain to detect multi-hop paths; (3) uniform RY (p5) + staggered RX on even qubits (p6) + CRX on odd qubits (p7) add local expressiveness without over-parameterizing. 7 params, no symmetry hypothesis to avoid equivariance verification failures seen previously. Structure inspired by c0002 (lowest dev risk 0.584) but replaces CRY-heavy entanglement with RZZ+CRZ to directly seed the diagonal observables the readout measures.

proposals.note: Cyclically-symmetric ring ansatz: two entangling RZZ layers on the 6-cycle (0-1-2-3-4-5-0) sandwich single-qubit RZ and RY rotations. All gates share tied parameters within each layer, giving 4 trainable params and exact invariance under the 6-cycle relabeling. The two RZZ layers propagate edge-encoding information around the ring, enabling the readout Z_i and Z_iZ_j observables to detect whether the graph is a single connected component. RY in the middle breaks the Z-axis degeneracy and adds expressivity without breaking cyclic symmetry. 24 gates, 4 params, 2 layers x 2 repeats.

proposals.note: 24-gate block with strict (0,1) transposition symmetry. All RZZ gates commute pairwise, and single-qubit RY gates on distinct wires commute, so each layer is individually invariant under the swap. Three RZZ parameter groups (c: qubit-0/1 to {1,2,3}; d: qubit-0/1 to {4,5}; e: within {2,3,4,5}) cover all 15 edges with 5 trainable angles. Prior proposal failed equivariance because gate ordering broke the claimed C6 symmetry; this design avoids that by using only commuting gate families within each layer. The (0,1) swap is a valid S6 subgroup preserving the connectivity label (verified: 0 violated fraction).

proposals.note: 23-gate block invariant under sigma=(01)(23)(45) (order 2). Structure: uniform RY layer, RZZ on three fixed-point pairs (th2), RZZ on two swapped-pair orbits (th3,th4), CNOT+CZ on swapped orbits (fixed gates), uniform RX layer. All RZZ gates commute (diagonal); CNOT pair and CZ pair act on disjoint qubits. The three-orbit RZZ structure (self-pairs, cross-pair-1, cross-pair-2) provides richer pairwise correlation encoding than prior 4-param proposals while keeping dev risk low. Connectivity is a graph property invariant under any node relabeling, so label preservation holds.

proposals.note: Ring-topology block with C6 cyclic symmetry. Two RY layers sandwich a RZZ layer (directly modulates Z_iZ_j readout correlations) and a CRX layer (off-diagonal entanglement around the ring). All six cycle edges share tied parameters, enforcing strict invariance under the 6-cycle relabeling. Connectivity is invariant under any node permutation, so the C6 subgroup is label-preserving. The ring geometry mirrors the path-propagation structure of graph connectivity: information flows around the cycle, and RZZ gates build up pairwise Z-correlations that the 21-observable readout can linearly combine to detect disconnection. Four tied parameters keep the model compact while the two-layer, two-repeat circuit provides depth for multi-hop path detection.

proposals.note: Fully cyclic-equivariant block under (0 1 2 3 4 5). Structure: one RY layer (all 6 wires, shared param) followed by three RZZ layers covering all 15 edges of K6 grouped by cyclic distance (d=1: 6 edges, d=2: 6 edges, d=3: 3 edges), each layer with a shared param. All RY gates commute with each other and all RZZ gates commute with each other, so within-layer ordering is irrelevant and the block is exactly equivariant under the cyclic group C6. The previous proposal failed equivariance because its gate set was not closed under the claimed permutation; here every orbit of the generator is explicitly instantiated with tied parameters. 21 gates, 4 trainable params, well within the 24-gate budget. The ansatz treats all nodes symmetrically, matching the label symmetry of the connectivity predicate.

proposals.note: Cyclically-symmetric block: 6 RY (all qubits, tied), 15 RZZ partitioned into 3 distance-orbits under C6 (d1:6, d2:6, d3:3, each orbit tied), plus 3 fixed CZ on the d3 pairs for extra diagonal entanglement. Key fix vs prior failed equivariance: all RY gates are grouped first (mutually commuting), then all diagonal gates (RZZ+CZ mutually commute). Since each orbit has a single tied parameter and the gate sets are invariant under the cyclic permutation, the block unitary commutes with the C6 permutation operator regardless of intra-group ordering. The CZ gates add a fixed pi/2 phase on antipodal pairs, enriching the Z_iZ_j readout landscape without breaking symmetry. 24 gates, 4 trainable parameters.
